description: Verifies the seal of a solution. Short form, which needs only what is short: request is the solve request as it was sent (the answer's inputs), and solution_seal is the seal its answer gave. The request is solved again, under a physics permit and the limits and refusals of solve, and the answer is holds, cause ("solution_seal" when the seal given is not the seal the request solves to), recomputed_solution_seal and recomputed_receipt_sha384 when it holds (else no seal: solve gives the true one), compared, and text_not_compared: no answer text the agent holds is compared. Long form: the whole solve answer sent back as it came, without request. Its solution seal is recomputed from its exact hex values and the part that fails is named, then its request is solved again under a physics permit and the engine's answer compared with it, value by value and byte for byte, receipt included: holds is true only when every byte is the engine's, values_hold when every value is, else cause names the part, solution_seal (the request solves to another seal), answer_text (with differs_at, the first field that differs) or engine_version (an answer of another version). A chained solve: its whole answer with from beside it; the upstream run is computed again and the chain held too (cause chain), with recomputed_chain_seal. Alone it is refused (AnswerCarriesNoRequest). Nothing is stored, so each form answers the same on every connection. On this open connection one address holds at most 1 physics permit at a time; a call that finds none is answered "Too many concurrent physics tasks." and nothing waits. An answer is waited for 60 seconds, and long work is stopped there.

inputSchema.description: Either request and solution_seal alone, the short form: the request is solved again and its seal compared with solution_seal. Or the whole solve answer sent back as it came, without request, the long form: held value by value and byte for byte, its signature verified first. A chained answer alone is refused (AnswerCarriesNoRequest), and a compact answer sent whole (CompactAnswerNeedsRequest).

from.description: Beside the whole answer of a chained solve: the from solve took (request, run_seal, coupling). The upstream run is computed again and held to its seal, each handed value to it, and the request solved again with it; the answer alone is refused (AnswerCarriesNoRequest).

inputs.description: The inputs of the solve answer, sent back as returned: the request that was solved. It is hashed, and solved again under a physics permit and the limits of solve.

public_key.description: The base64 of the ML-DSA-87 public key (2,592 bytes) to verify the answer's signature with; without it, this engine's own.

request.description: With solution_seal alone: the solve request as it was sent (the answer's inputs). It is solved again, under a physics permit and the limits of solve, and its seal is compared with solution_seal. Its fields are solve's.

seen_nonces.description: Nonces of signatures already seen: one of them again is SignatureNonceReplayed.

solution_seal.description: The solution_seal of the solve answer: with request, or as part of the whole answer.
